**Goal `ldap`, Stage 9 (the AD extras) is under way**: sort with a VLV window, deleted objects and DirSync are on `main`. `sort_and_a_vlv_window_return_the_requested_slice`, `show_deleted_finds_a_deleted_entry` and `dirsync_returns_only_what_changed_since_its_cookie` pass against `samba-ad`, and so does `tests/conformance/core/ldap-sync-cookie.nvst`. Stages 1 to 5, 7 and 8 are done. Stage 4 is done except for a CA that a program supplies. Stage 6 is done except wiring the schema into the readers. Stage 9's Global Catalog is the one item left.

**On `main`**: everything Stage 8 listed, sort and window, `showDeleted`, and now `Connection::changes(Filter, {base?, select?, cookie?}): Changes` with `Changes::cookie(): tainted bytes`. `crates/nvs-ldap/src/conn.rs`'s module doc ("A sync pages by its own cookie") says how `Cursor::changes` works and why it adds the filter's attributes and `isDeleted` to a non-empty select (Samba matches the filter against selected attributes only and sends a deletion only when `isDeleted` is selected). `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/search.rs`'s module doc says how `Ldap\Changes` shares `Ldap\Entries`' first three slots and one `advance`.

Server cases reach `samba-ad` (`tests/db/compose.yaml`) at `ldaps://localhost:16636`, and plain LDAP at 16389. Write cases add and delete their own entries under names no other case uses: OUs `Shop`/`Blog`/`Store`/`Framework`/`Example`/`Catalog`/`Library`/`Gallery`/`Studio`/`Archive`/`Theater`/`Cinema`/`Garden` (cases) and `Museum`/`Harbor` (Rust) at the root, and each test user `CN=<name>,OU=<name>` in an OU of its own (`Team`, `Editors`, `Visitors`, `Members`, `Readers` in Rust; `Staff`, `Authors`, `Owners`, `Clients` in cases). Grep the name across `tests/conformance/core/ldap-*.nvst` and `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/ldap.rs` before taking one. A deleted entry cannot be removed, so a test that deletes must not assume it is the only tombstone.
